brief:
Settlers began expansion work on a newly established agricultural outpost near the Bedouin communities of Al-Mhattash and Al-Araara east of occupied Jerusalem, Shehab Wire reported. The work commenced Sunday evening and continued Monday morning, threatening residents' land and presence in the area.

The outpost represents an escalation in settlement activity targeting Bedouin communities in the region, which have faced repeated displacement pressures from Israeli settlement expansion.

title: Settlers expand outpost near Bedouin community east of Jerusalem
